usage.finalMessage:
I added `reminders <date>`, which uses the 48-hour reminder rule in force (DEC-C08), and `help` lists it straight after `reminder <appointment>`. All 9 tests pass and everything is committed in `d9de024`. The existing `reminder` command still uses the old 24-hour rule, so the two commands now disagree.
I left out the rejected DEC-W-4. Appointments at the same date and time come out in id order only by accident, and the report asks Patient Services to decide the order.
The report also asks whether `reminder` should move to 48 hours too; it is in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: completed
